## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

HomeViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/home/HomeViewModel.kt

## Trigger

`linkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()` firing, and `onSyncClicked` —
both observed already, in `HomeViewModel`'s `init` block and its own
method.

## Today

Both of `HomeViewModel`'s call sites hardcode `raceInProgress = false`
when calling `recordedRaceSyncService.sync(raceInProgress = false, at)`
— at line 82 (link established) and line 145 (`onSyncClicked`).
Meanwhile `ProfileSyncListenerService.onMessageReceived` derives the
same condition on every profile message it receives:
`raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress().getOrNull() != null`.
`HomeViewModel`'s constructor injects `RaceRepository` (the reference/
history repository) but not `RaceRecordingRepository` — the repository
`findInProgress()` lives on — so nothing in `HomeViewModel` can compute
that condition today.

## Expected

Both of `HomeViewModel`'s calls to `recordedRaceSyncService.sync`
derive `raceInProgress` the same way `ProfileSyncListenerService` does
— `raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress().getOrNull() != null` —
instead of the hardcoded `false`. This requires `RaceRecordingRepository`
to be injected into `HomeViewModel`, which it currently is not: a
second gap, since the bearer cannot compute the condition without that
dependency reaching it first.
